items.title: 【工具自荐】2026全年公休假与考试日历（最全整理版） 可视化倒计时网站
items.author: TickHaiJun
items.content: 每年一到年初，很多人都会有同一种焦虑：假期怎么安排？考试怎么规划？ 真正让人慌的不是事情多，而是时间线太乱。 所以我把 2026 全年公休假 + 重点考试时间 做了一次整理，并做成了一个可视化日历网站，方便自己用，也分享给大家。 这份内容适合两类人： 打工人（看假期、做拼假计划）和 考证党（看考试节点、排备考节奏）。 比如： 春节（2月15日-23日）连休9天，适合提前规划返乡/旅行； 5月 是财会、软考、建筑类考试密集期； 9月-11月 建造师、法考、执业药师等重磅考试接连来临，是全年备考硬仗阶段。 我做这个工具时，尽量把它做得简单、干净、耐看： 支持深色模式、卡片翻转、倒计时按“天/周”查看，让时间不只是一个日期，而是更有体感的节奏提醒。 希望它能陪你走过 2026 那些重要时刻：放假、出发、备考、上岸、见想见的人。 > 工具地址：https://deadline-wheat.vercel.app/

items.title: [工具自荐] APA Citation Generator — AI 辅助 APA 引用生成器（支持 URL/DOI，缺失字段可解释）
items.author: liuyan-wjy
items.summary: 项目名称：APA Citation Generator 项目地址： 这是一个面向论文写作场景的 APA 7 引用生成工具，重点解决“网页元数据不完整导致作者/日期缺失”的问题。 核心特点： 输入 URL 或 DOI，自动生成 APA reference + intext citation 规则优先提取元数据，AI 仅补缺失字段（降低幻觉） 给出置信度与 Needs Review 提示，便于人工复核 支持手动编辑后重新生成引用 已接入 Google 登录、配额/积分体系与 PayPal 支付 技术栈： Next.js + Supabase + OpenRouter + PayPal + Vercel 已做安全加固：SSRF 防护、OAuth 回调重定向限制、nonce CSP、表单防刷等 欢迎体验和反馈，尤其是复杂网页/边缘引用场景的准确性建议。
items.content:
项目名称：APA Citation Generator  
项目地址：https://apacitationgenerator.online  

这是一个面向论文写作场景的 APA 7 引用生成工具，重点解决“网页元数据不完整导致作者/日期缺失”的问题。

核心特点：
- 输入 URL 或 DOI，自动生成 APA reference + in-text citation
- 规则优先提取元数据，AI 仅补缺失字段（降低幻觉）
- 给出置信度与 Needs Review 提示，便于人工复核
- 支持手动编辑后重新生成引用
- 已接入 Google 登录、配额/积分体系与 PayPal 支付

技术栈：
- Next.js + Supabase + OpenRouter + PayPal + Vercel
- 已做安全加固：SSRF 防护、OAuth 回调重定向限制、nonce CSP、表单防刷等

欢迎体验和反馈，尤其是复杂网页/边缘引用场景的准确性建议。

items.title: LazyOS.ai
items.summary: AI Tools as Apps. Pay-per-use with Battery Credits.
items.content: LazyOS.ai is an AI Operating System where each tool works like a standalone app. Instead of expensive subscriptions, users buy Battery Credits and only pay for what they use. From background removal to image generation, every feature runs as a simple, focused tool. No complex models, no monthly lock-ins — just open, use, and spend battery based on usage. Built for creators, small businesses, and anyone tired of subscription overload.

items.title: Lawn

items.title: Wordwand

items.content: Wordwand puts AI inside every app, right where you type. Ask AI anything and get the answer inline - like ChatGPT, but without leaving what you're doing. Dictate with your voice. Listen to any text, even in podcast mode. Fix grammar and translate to 40+ languages. One shortcut. Any Mac app and browser. No copy-paste. Try it for free (5,000 words/month).

items.title: Nuyo
items.summary: AI-powered walking routes for Manhattan
items.content: Nuyo differs from maps, travel blogs, and tour apps by focusing on dynamic exploration rather than logistics and generic city guides. Routes are generated in real time and structured as loops, so you end where you started. The AI layer is contextual and interactive, adapting to your preferences and allowing interactions from the user every time you reach a spot. Built specifically for Manhattan, it combines route logic, curated local data, and conversational AI into one continuous experience.

items.title: Loopdesk
items.summary: World's first agentic video editor
items.content: The world needs your stories, not your hours lost in timelines. Focus on what moves people. We'll handle every cut. AI-powered video editing for creators.

items.title: Spec Coding
items.summary: pec-First AI Dev Tool for Global Developers
items.content: Spec Coding is a spec-first AI dev tool for global teams. Turn requirements into testable specs, API contracts, and acceptance criteria to ship faster.

items.title: IronClaw
items.summary: Secure, open-source alternative to OpenClaw
items.content: OpenClaw is powerful, but give it real credentials and you're exposed. Prompt injections steal API keys. Malicious skills grab passwords. IronClaw fixes this. Your credentials live in an encrypted vault inside a TEE — injected at the network boundary only for approved endpoints. The AI never sees the raw values. Every tool is Wasm-sandboxed. Outbound traffic is scanned for leaks. Built in Rust. Open source. Deploy on NEAR AI Cloud in one click.

items.title: CookLLM
items.summary: Go deep. Build real things.
items.content: CookLLM is a hands-on LLM engineering course where you build everything from scratch — tokenizer, model architecture, GPU kernels, Flash Attention, pretraining, and RLHF — with interactive visualizations and zero black boxes.

items.title: My Income
items.summary: Track money. Plan budgets. Understand your finances.
items.content: My Income is a privacy-focused finance app that brings all your money matters into one place. With support for multiple accounts (cash, bank, cards, wallets), income & expense tracking, budgets, charts, recurring transactions, forecasts, and customizable categories, it helps you see where your money goes and make smarter financial decisions—without ads or unnecessary permissions.

items.content: Open iT StorageAnalyzer™ monitors and analyzes disk and backup usage to help organizations optimize storage resources and reduce costs. It identifies unused or unnecessary data that can be deleted or moved to lower-cost storage, supports accurate chargeback, and provides insights into capacity trends. StorageAnalyzer enables proactive storage management, prevents capacity issues, and supports better planning for future storage investments.

items.title: WWChat

items.content: WWChat breaks language barriers with AI-powered real-time translation. Write in your language — your friend reads in theirs. Features: AI assistant @W in any chat, built-in crypto wallet for USDT transfers, voice message transcription, channels with auto-translation, HD audio/video calls, and E2E encryption with a duress PIN that wipes secret chats under pressure. Available on iOS, Android, Web, macOS, and Windows.

items.title: Aura Social
items.summary: The professional network with predictable promotion.
items.content: Aura is a professional network built for creators and companies who are tired of auction-driven advertising. Instead of bidding wars, fluctuating CPCs, and fragmented dashboards, Aura offers predictable promotion through fixed subscription tiers. Personal identity and company workspaces are separated by design, enabling role-based access control, team governance, and built-in analytics within a single platform. Free to join. Activate the promotion only when you choose.

items.title: z-image.fun

Users can produce professional portraits, stylized art, and branded visuals with minimal effort. Designed for designers, marketers, and creators seeking fast, scalable visual production without complex workflows.

items.title: BETOFF
items.summary: Anonymous self-control tool for gambling recovery
items.content: BETOFF is a specialized tool designed to help people overcome gambling addiction through discipline and transparency. Unlike simple timers, it features a 3-phase recovery system (A/B/C) with mandatory check-ins to verify progress. Users get a private Progress Card accessible via a secret ID, allowing them to share their gambling-free status with loved ones anonymously and securely.
